free_tier.stated: Hobby is USD 0 a month 'plus usage, billed per second', including 5 vCPU-hours and 420 memory GB-hours each month, 20 GB of network egress and 5,000 sandbox creations.

per_object_cap.stated: max sandbox runtime 45 minutes on Hobby, 24 hours on Pro; 10 concurrent sandboxes on Hobby, 50 on Pro

retention.stated: Not stated on the pricing page: a 45-minute maximum runtime means nothing survives a session unless the sandbox is durable, and durable sandboxes are listed as 'Not available' on Hobby.

egress.terms: 20 GB of network egress included each month on Hobby (100 GB Pro, 1,000 GB Team); overage is USD 0.15 per GB on Hobby and Pro and USD 0.12 per GB on Team

interface_detail: REST API (api.sandbox.stateset.app), Node.js SDK and Python SDK; no CLI or SSH found in the docs read

limits.value: 45 minutes maximum sandbox runtime on Hobby, 24 hours on Pro (USD 49/month)

identity_cost.detail: The Hobby plan is USD 0 plus usage, which normally needs a card on file to meter beyond the included hours; no card, hold or debit statement was read on the pricing page. Unverified.

reliability_note: Shared sandboxes 'burst on Spot capacity at the lowest price and can be preempted', which is an interruption a user cannot schedule around.
confidence_note: The runtime caps, concurrency, included hours and the spot-preemption sentence are quoted from the pricing page read. The unit rates, the card requirement and SSH access are not established.

evidence.proved: '$25 in trial credits. No credit card required' with '$0.028/hour', 'Pay for the time a sandbox runs, not a rounded-up hour', '$25 trial ≈ 892 hours' of a '4 vCPU · 8 GB shared sandbox', and 'Explicit CPU, memory, and sandbox lifetime limits', quoted
quoted: 'Hobby ... Limits ... Max sandbox runtime 45 minutes ... Concurrent sandboxes 10 ... Durable sandboxes Not available'; 'Pro $49/month ... Max sandbox runtime 24 hours'

quoted: 'Shared sandboxes burst on Spot capacity at the lowest price and can be preempted; dedicated sandboxes get guaranteed CPU and memory, billed on 50% of their size ($0.2984/hour for the same size on Pro).'
egress overage is USD 0.15 per GB on Hobby and Pro, USD 0.12 on Team

evidence.quote: Create, execute, and manage sandboxes using the REST API, Node.js SDK, or Python SDK.

notes: No 730-hour figure exists to record because the product cannot run for 730 hours: 45 minutes is the Hobby cap and 24 hours the Pro cap. The byline prices the reference 4 vCPU / 8 GB shared sandbox at USD 0.028/hour, which would be USD 20.44 at 730 h if it could run that long - it cannot.

shape.note: the shared reference sandbox the page headlines

session_cap.note: 45 minutes on Hobby, 24 hours on Pro (USD 49/month)

network_out.ports: not stated on the pricing page

extras.price_arithmetic: Not computable as a 24/7 figure: the Hobby cap is 45 minutes per sandbox and the Pro cap is 24 hours, so no shape can be held for 730 h. At the headline USD 0.028/hour for 4 vCPU / 8 GB, 730 h would be USD 20.44 if it were purchasable.

binding_note: A 45-minute wall-clock cap reaps the machine before a monthly budget can matter, so the cap is the wall and price is irrelevant.
